visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens with a wide shot of an ornate traditional Chinese temple altar. Multiple golden and dark-clothed deity statues are arranged in tiers, flanked by colorful flags and intricate wood carvings. The background features a large painting of a dragon. Bright indoor lighting illuminates the scene. (2) The camera transitions to a close-up of a thick, vertical incense stick standing in a large bronze burner filled with ash and many smaller red-tipped incense sticks. The setting is a temple interior with red tile flooring and a dark wooden table in the background. (3) A human hand enters the frame holding a green and white mini 4WD racing toy car. The hand rotates the car in a circular motion directly over the rising white smoke from the incense stick. The car is modified with green rollers and high-capacity batteries. (4) A rapid montage shows different angles of the car's underside and chassis as it continues to be 'blessed' over the incense smoke. The mechanical components and metallic weights of the toy are clearly visible under the bright light. (5) The shot stabilizes as the hand holds the car upright. Inside the cockpit, two small figures resembling a cat and a girl are visible. The hand continues the ritualistic circling motion before the video ends.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video presents a humorous and superstitious ritual where a hobbyist seeks divine blessing for a racing toy car in a temple. The juxtaposition of modern 'mini 4WD' technology with traditional incense rituals creates a comedic irony.
